headline: Brief links open on Google Drive workspaces — a saved recap no longer answers a click with "Failed to load local file."

items.prompt_template: A fix from the field: on a workspace that lives in Google Drive, meeting briefs and weekly recaps saved fine, but clicking their links answered "Failed to load local file." — the link pointed at a place that only exists on this side, never on your machine. Links for Drive-hosted workspaces now open the document in Google Drive itself, where the file actually lives. Workspaces in a regular local folder are untouched — those links keep opening exactly as before. Nothing to do on your side; the change arrives with your next scheduled brief or recap.
